scope: The eight compiled runtime curriculum books
sourceType: Site-generated synthetic pronunciation, not publisher recordings
audioBundleDigestFormat: SHA-256 of JSON-encoded [relative path, file SHA-256] pairs sorted by relative path

leadingSilence.comparisonDetectionThreshold: absolute signed 16-bit sample amplitude greater than 164
leadingSilence.note: Encoded sound onset only; these figures exclude network, browser, and speaker latency. Quiet consonants and complete word endings are retained.

normalization.homographContext: live, close, read, wind, minute, and use are generated in disambiguating sentences, then extracted after an acoustic pause with their complete final sound retained.

reproduce: With edge-tts and FFmpeg or imageio-ffmpeg installed, set WORDPLANET_DECODE_AUDIO=1 and run Python with -B src/pronunciation/test_generate_audio.py.
